articles.title: Resident Evil Is Now The Highest-Rated Gaming Movie Ever
articles.summary: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18. Reviews from critics went live today, and the movie is earning high scores.
body: In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever. It boasts a mightily impressive 96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 71 reviews and an equally impressive 80 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic. According to Metacritic, Resident Evil is the highest-rated video game movie ever, well ahead of another 2026 movie, Exit 8, which has a 71 Metascore.

The six Resident Evil movies that Paul W.S. Anderson made did not score very high with critics, with 2016's The Final Chapter topping them all at 49% on Metacritic. The latest Resident Evil movie before Cregger's, 2021's Welcome to Raccoon City from director Johannes Roberts, scored a 44% on Metacritic.

After that movie came out, Constantin, which has owned the movie rights to Resident Evil since the '90s, intended to put the franchise on hiatus. However, Cregger, coming off the success of Barbarian, pitched Constantin on his new, original take, and Constantin loved it so much that they put it into production.
points: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18.
In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever.

articles.title: Quentin Tarantino’s New Novel The Adventures of Cliff Booth Is Up for Preorder
articles.summary: Here’s one for film buffs who also enjoy curling up with a good book: Quentin Tarantino has a new novel coming out soon. It’s called The Adventures of Cliff Booth, and it’s a novelization of the upcoming movie The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, which is a stand-alone sequel to Once Upon a…
body: According to the blurb, the book follows the Brad Pitt character Cliff Booth, a “war hero, stuntman, bartender, cinema projectionist,” as he navigates 1977 Hollywood, performing “clandestine services” for his friends. Since Once Upon a Time in Hollywood toook place in 1969, that means this is set eight years after the exciting events of that movie.

That’s about all we know so far about the book – or the movie for that matter (you can watch the all-vibes trailer here ). It looks like Netflix re-named the movie just two weeks ago from “The Adventures of Cliff Booth” to “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,” so we shall see if the same title change comes to the book in the future. In the meantime, you can lock in your preorder now and it’ll ship on December 8, when it’s released.

This isn’t the first time Tarantino has penned a novel. He also wrote a novelization for Once Upon a Time in Hollywood that’s currently on sale at Amazon for $6. Tarantino isn’t just writing novels for goofs, either. The New York Times gave that book a positive review, calling it a “pulpy page-turner.” In 2022, Tarantino also published a nonfiction book called Cinema Speculation.

articles.title: Pirate Who Cracked Denuvo Games Like Resident Evil Requiem Plans to Keep Doing So Despite Being Sued
articles.summary: A pirate known for cracking games that utilize the DRM software Denuvo is being hit with a lawsuit... but that isn't stopping them from continuing on. For years, PC games have attempted to shield themselves from piracy with a DRM software known as Denuvo.
body: As spotted by GamesRadar, the pirate is now being sued by Denuvo, so long as the company can actually identify who they are. The company is working to unmask this anonymous pirate and there's likely hope that even if they aren't successful, the pressure of an investigation will maybe spook voices38 into disappearing. That's not the case, though. voices38 took to Reddit to issue a statement, telling fellow pirates that "all is fine" and "everything will continue as normal."

It's an interesting story, and one that only feels all the more relevant with the recent GTA 6 leaks, when a leaker obtained access to the build of the highly anticipated game and taunted Rockstar Games with various messages. Once the game was properly revealed, the leaker vanished, and as of a month later, there has been no word as to whether or not they've been caught. Whether they'll return to cause more chaos remains to be seen, but it is pretty evident that online hackers and lawbreakers are getting good at evading detection.
Whether voices38 can continue to crack these games and get away with it is up in the air, but they certainly think they can.

articles.title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Gives Harley Quinn An Arkham Asylum Makeover
articles.summary: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this year, but if you're tired of saving Gotham, you can embrace chaos with two of the city's greatest villains: Harley Quinn and the Joker.
body: While Harley Quinn predominantly wore a jester's outfit throughout her appearances in Batman: The Animated Series and related comic books, Rocksteady's Arkham Asylum game saw her switch up her look dramatically for what can best be described as a doctor-themed dominatrix. Out with the spandex onesie, in with a repurposed doctor's outfit, leather corset, domino mask, and other elements that paid homage to her roots. In Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, this costume is described as having prankster pigtails and a "chaotic" corset.

In case you missed it, the Mayhem Collection draws heavily from Batman: The Animated Series, with developer TT Games calling the expansion a love letter to the landmark '90s show that introduced Harley Quinn as the Joker's sidekick. Fans can find several references to the series in the Mayhem Collection, along with Easter eggs for other Batman shows, films, games, and comic book stories. There's even a nod to Harley Quinn's original voice actor, the late Arleen Sorkin, and the new story mission chronicles the first meeting between the Joker and Quinn, back when she was still the ambitious psychiatrist Dr. Harleen Quinzel.

articles.title: The MSI Codex Z2C RTX 5070 Prebuilt Gaming PC Drops to $1399 and Includes an Upcoming PC Game
articles.summary: B&H Photo is offering a solid deal on a prebuilt desktop computer that excels at 1080p and 1440p gaming. For a limited time you can pick up a brand new MSI Codex Z2C RTX 5070 gaming PC for just $1,399 with free shipping.
body: The MSI Codex Z2C gaming PC is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU, GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD. The Ryzen 7 8700F is an 8-core, 16-thread processor with a max boost clock of 5.1GHz. It's not the fastest or newest AMD CPU, but it's still a solid gaming CPU that won't bottleneck the GPU, especially at the higher resolutions you should be playing at if you own a 5070 Ti. A 750W PSU powers the system.

The GeForce RTX 5070 is the best Nvidia card for 1080p and 1440p gaming and by itself this card retails for $600 (although generally it's higher these days). It's also powerful enough to run most games at 4K, although at that point you'll see noticeable gains jumping up to a 5070 Ti. Compared to the previous generation GPUs, the RTX 5070 offers a slight performance improvement over the RTX 4070 Super, which was and still is an excellent GPU. The fps gain is greater in games that support DLSS 4.5 with multi-frame generation. Check out our RTX 5070 review.

articles.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Fantastic Reviews Have Me Feeling FOMO
articles.summary: Here we go again: A new Fire Emblem game is garnering glowing reviews, and I'm thinking this could be the one that finally clicks with me. Launching tomorrow on Switch 2, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave sits at a fantastic 89 metascore (at the time of publication) on GameSpot's sister site Metacritic.
body: In addition, GameSpot's Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave review says this is "the new high point to beat for future entries." As someone who didn't plan to buy the strategy RPG, I'm now second-guessing myself. I have a history of buying well-reviewed Fire Emblem games, trying them out for maybe five hours, and then bouncing off them for something else. That was especially true of Fire Emblem: Three Houses on Switch in 2019.

Before that, my first foray into the series came in 2013 with Fire Emblem Awakening on the Nintendo 3DS, if you don’t consider me maining Marth in Super Smash Bros. Melee. This is a game I still have downloaded on my 3DS XL, which sits in the drawer of my bedside table. I've tried so many times to engage with the game, only to stop after a couple of hours. Once again, I don't dislike the turn-based action, but for some reason, it never fully connects. I'm obviously in the minority, because Fire Emblem Awakening basically saved the entire series.

articles.title: Call Of Duty: Black Ops Dev Teases “Something That Nobody’s Ever Experienced Before”
articles.summary: Veteran Call of Duty developer Treyarch is finishing up its work on Black Ops 7 and shifting to its next project, but what will that be? That remains to be seen, but Treyarch design director Kevin Drew said in a new Dev Talk video that it might not be what you expect.
body: Drew said Treyarch has "learned a lot" working on 2024's Black Ops 6 and 2025's Black Ops 7 and "tried a lot of things in our current era."
"But we're ready to make something new and something that nobody's ever experienced before," he said.
That sounds hyperbolic and extreme, and Call of Duty studios are definitely known for grandiose claims.

Treyarch created the Black Ops series, which debuted in 2010, and it remains one of the most popular brands within the franchise. In an unusual move, back-to-back Black Ops games came out in 2024 and 2025, and Treyarch itself admitted it did worry about franchise fatigue.
points: Veteran Call of Duty developer Treyarch is finishing up its work on Black Ops 7 and shifting to its next project, but what will that be?

articles.title: More MindsEye developers have been laid off, and GTA veteran Leslie Benzie's studio is reportedly shutting down
articles.summary: Another round of layoffs is seemingly sweeping through Build A Rocket Boy, the studio responsible for MindsEye and founded by GTA veteran Leslie Benzies. The studio's future is now uncertain.
body: Reported on by IGN, more staff working at Build A Rocket Boy have said they've been let go. Head of audio Stuart Ross, level designer Liam Shannon, release manager Michaela Emslie, lead QA analyst Sandy Greig, QA analyst Elizabet Tyaneva, production QA analyst Cameron Deaves, and many more recently announced their time at the studio is coming to a close.

This certainly isn't the first time Build A Rocket Boy has cut jobs following the messy launch (and even more messy aftermath) of MindsEye. Last year, the company made an unknown number of staff redundant. In May, the studio reportedly laid off a further 170 workers. Remaining staff also staged a protest this summer against Build A Rocket Boy's "all expenses paid" fan event.
These most recent layoffs also call into question the future of the entire company. Kotaku reports that sources close to the studio claim Build A Rocket Boy is permanently shutting down.

articles.title: Epic X-Men Villain Is Absolutely Terrorizing Marvel’s Wolverine Players
articles.summary: James "Logan" Howlett, also known as the superhero Wolverine, loves himself good whiskey. I, too, poured myself some whiskey the other night while fighting Omega Red, the startlingly challenging first boss in Marvel's Wolverine.
body: Released Sept. 15 for PlayStation 5, Marvel's Wolverine is the latest from Insomniac Games, set in the same fictional universe as the studio's popular Spider-Man series. Wolverine takes a bit of a different tack than those games: It's a linear action game, rather than an open-world RPG, and befitting its star, is significantly more violent to boot. Wolverine carves through waves of enemies, dismembering and decapitating goons by the dozen.

So it is a bit of a shock when you come across an enemy you can't just slice through. At the end of the first mission, which tasks you with rescuing Nathanial Essex from a paramilitary facility, you're stopped by Omega Red, the sad result of a Soviet experiment meant to recreate Captain America's super-soldier serum. The Omega Red boss fight is, dare I say, almost Soulslike in nature: survival means dodging, parrying, and counterattacking at the right time across three increasingly challenging phases.

articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds will soon stop charging players to edit their characters as Capcom scraps the game's worst microtransaction
articles.summary: Arguably Monster Hunter Wilds ' most egregious microtransaction is being retired, and, soon, you'll be able to edit your hunters and cat-friend Palicos whenever you like, as many times as you like.
body: Publisher Capcom waved goodbye to the divisive Edit Vouchers earlier today. Starting from 3 December, the vouchers will be pulled from all digital storefronts and players will instead get 10 Character Edit Vouchers and 10 Palico Edit Vouchers for free.

Those vouchers should tide you over until the release of Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance sometime next year, at which point "all players will be able to re-edit the appearance of their hunter and Palico as many times as they like, free of charge and without the need for a Character Edit Voucher." Even if you're not planning on picking up the Ascendance expansion, you'll still be able to give your characters a makeover ad nauseum, I should add.

Mildly whelming news for anyone who's already spent real-world money on rejigging your big beast battlers: you won't be refunded, but Capcom will give you an in-game pendant set "as a token of our appreciation." You can claim the Special Thank-You Pendant Set, which includes the Heavenly Hog and Beelzeboar pendants, starting from 3 December, as well. Gosh, this series has the best monster names.

articles.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Is Officially the Highest Grossing Film in Domestic Box Office History
articles.summary: Spider-Man is on top of the world. After 47 days in theaters, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has overtaken Star Wars: The Force Awakens to become the highest-grossing film in domestic box office history. Spidey reached $936.773 million on Tuesday, overtaking The Force Awakens ’ 936 million.
body: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has also performed excellently at the global box office and is currently at $2.45 billion, putting it behind only Avatar ($2.9 billion) and Avengers: Endgame ($2.7 billion). James Cameron films round out the rest of the top five, with Avatar: The Way of Water ($2.3 billion) and Titanic ($2.2 billion).

A remaining test for Brand New Day is whether it can become the first film to clear $1 billion at the domestic box office. While it is still technically possible, the feat seems unlikely now without a re-release, given it made around $12-13 million from Sept. 8 to Sept. 14. Brand New Day got off to an explosive domestic debut that grossed $360 million, giving it the biggest opening weekend ever in the U.S. It should be noted that these figures are not adjusted for inflation. If they were, Gone with the Wind would still trounce the competition: the film grossed over $200 million in the U.S., which would put it at almost $1.9 billion in modern currency.

articles.title: Dragon Quest Celebrates 40th Anniversary by Passing a Huge Milestone
articles.summary: On May 27, 1986, a company called Enix released a game called Dragon Quest in Japan. 40 years later, that company is now Square Enix and Dragon Quest has become one of the most popular and influential RPG series of all time.
body: The Dragon Quest X account posted on the morning of Sept. 16 that the series has surpassed 100 million units sold over its entire lifetime. To celebrate, Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii shared a special message to fans. "Thank you all so much," Horii said, "As Dragon Quest reaches its 40th anniversary milestone, I'm filled with gratitude that we can share such wonderful news. We'll continue working hard to bring you adventures that fill you with excitement, and I hope you'll continue to support us." He then got to dig into an adorable cake decorated with monsters from the series.

There have been 11 mainline games in the series to date, as well as numerous spin-offs across genres. There are also novels, manga, and anime adaptations. Later this year, Square Enix will release Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World.

articles.title: Vampire RPG escapes Steam's 'Adult Only' jail just in time for launch: "At the risk of disappointing some players, Nighthawks is not porn"
articles.summary: Nighthawks just got a happy ending. Developers of the vampiric RPG have successfully removed the game's 'Adult Only' rating on Steam - a label that would have otherwise hidden the game from most players.
body: "Last weekend, Nighthawks was mistakenly classified as 'Adults Only' by Valve. This put Nighthawks into a category usually reserved for porn games and rendered it almost invisible on the Steam storefront," the developers write in a statement posted to Steam. "At the risk of disappointing some players, Nighthawks is not porn. Sexy? Sure. Deals with mature themes? Definitely. Porn? Most definitely not. Anyone playing Nighthawks expecting lots of sex and nudity will leave very disappointed. Any sexy scenes are text only, and the few scenes with nudity are presented with strategically placed props and hands covering up the naughty bits."

While the debacle kept the team scrambling for a few days, they acknowledged that Valve were apparently "very helpful in expediting the review on our appeal so we could get the AO rating dropped." The devs still aren't sure exactly what made Valve's flaming red eye turn on them, either, but the scandal supposedly doubled the game's wishlists.

videos.summary: Take a look at the Official Trailer 2 for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, an upcoming film starring Joseph Zada, Jesse Plemons, Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, Mckenna Grace, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, and Kelvin Harrison Jr.
body: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will revisit the world of Panem twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping screenplay is by Billy Ray. It is based on the novel by Suzanne Collins. It is produced by Nina Jacobson, Brad Simpson, and Francis Lawrence.
